feeds.title: Boundless Blog
feeds.description: Boundless is a community for Christian young adults who want to grow up, own their faith, date with purpose, and prepare for marriage and family. Our goal is to mature young adults in Christ as the foundation for marriage and family while providing an inspiring and refreshingly real online community in which to share the journey.

feeds.title: Student Devos
feeds.description: Daily devotions for youth, teens and discipleship tools.

feeds.title: Micheala Y Goba
feeds.description: A Christian Youth blog designed to encourage Christian youths to grow and mature spiritually at the same time enjoying their walk with Christ. We create Blog posts on Christian living, spiritual growth, we share experiences, battles, and struggles. We create inspirational quotes, interview other Christian youth creatives, free Christian novels for download, and lots more.

feeds.title: Life Teen Blog
feeds.description: As a Eucharist-centered movement within the Roman Catholic Church, Life Teen leads teenagers and their families into a deeper relationship with Jesus Christ and His Church. With the Blessed Virgin Mary as our intercessor and guide, Life Teen seeks to unleash the fullness of the Sacramental power present within the young Church.

feeds.title: Christian Teen & Young Adult Blog
feeds.description: Answers about dating, mental health, defending your faith, understanding the Bible, and more. A Christian teen & young adult blog that covers it all.

feeds.title: Christian Tween Girls
feeds.description: The Christian Tween Girls Blog is a Bible-driven platform designed to inspire and equip tween and teen girls to live out their Christian faith with courage, purpose, and joy.

feeds.title: Rooted Ministry
feeds.description: Rooted exists to transform student ministry by fostering grace-driven and cross-centered leaders through rich theological and contextual engagement.

feeds.title: Little Faith Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Little Faith Blog! Our goal is to inspire girls to grow closer to Jesus Christ each and every day. Feel free to look around! Some things you'll find on our site are monthly Bible reading plans, ideas for the Little Faith Book, devotions, prayer requests, Bible journaling & much more!

feeds.title: LifeWay Young Adults
feeds.description: LifeWay Young Adults offers Bible study resources and events for young adults. Our mission is to connect our generation to Christ and His church.

feeds.title: The Rebelution
feeds.description: The Rebelution is a teenage rebellion against low expectations - a worldwide campaign to reject apathy, embrace responsibility, and do hard things.

feeds.title: Power to Change Blog
feeds.description: We are a movement of Jesus-followers who are on a mission to help students discover Jesus. For us this means we are longing for the day when no student in Canada graduates without engaging in the life-changing message of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Transformed 4 More Blog
feeds.description: We are a ministry for teeanage girls. We want to help teens grow in their walk with God and successfully navigate these crazy teenage years. We post about God, dating, friendships, relationships, money, college, high school, and other things pertinent to teen life.

feeds.title: FOR SUCH A TIME AS THIS
feeds.description: For Such A Time As This is a blog written for teen girls coming into their faith. It is a place to shake off the comforts and muck of the world and looks deeper into the immeasurable love God has for us all! We have been entrusted with the truth and so we should walk with courage in our hearts and hope in our God because we were intentionally placed in such a time as this!

feeds.title: To All You Princesses
feeds.description: A blog for Christian girls and young women who desire to know more about their identity in Christ.

feeds.title: Christian Teen Life
feeds.description: Welcome to the Christian Teen Life blog! Here, we'll explore how Jesus can help you with the struggles and stresses of being a teenager.

feeds.title: Christian Teen Girls
feeds.description: It's not easy to be a teen girl today with all the peer pressure that's around. This blog was made with the purpose of giving girls encouragement to live God's way.
